_meta.description: Approximate per-file flutter test wall-clock cost, used as bin-packing weights for CI shard balancing.
_meta.method: Parsed timestamps from the 8 'Test (shard N)' job logs of the run above. Each test-result line (pass or skip) carries a timestamp and its source file; duration for a file is the wall-clock gap between its last printed line and the previous file's last printed line (first file in a shard is measured from the step start). This is an approximation, not a precise per-file benchmark: files that run concurrently within a shard can have their cost attributed to whichever file's output happened to print at that moment. test/performance/profile_series_benchmark_test.dart is excluded from CI via --exclude-tags performance and is listed at 0.
